summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Pipeline page UI redesign completed successfully. All 14 test scenarios passed. New expandable card design, collapsible sections, filter chips, view toggle, and mobile responsiveness all working correctly. 'Mark as Replied' button successfully removed per user request.
passed_tests: Pipeline page loads at /pipeline with all 10 schools displayed
Sections display correctly: 'Needs Outreach' (2), 'Waiting on Reply' (3), 'In Conversation' (4), 'Committed' (1 - Stanford)
Filter chips work: 'All 10', 'Outreach 2', 'Waiting 3', 'In Convo 4', 'Committed 1' - clicking filters shows/hides sections
View toggle: 'Compact' (default, cards collapsed) and 'Expanded' (all cards expanded) works correctly
Card expand/collapse: clicking card toggles expanded content with Coach info, Match Score, Outreach stats
No 'Mark as Replied' or 'Mark Replied' button found on pipeline page (removed as requested)
Section headers are collapsible: clicking chevron hides/shows section cards
Action buttons: 'Start Outreach' for outreach section, 'Follow Up' for waiting section, 'Journey' for all
Expanded card shows: Coach name+email, Match score with progress bar, Outreach count
Navigation: 'Journey' and 'View Full Journey' buttons navigate to /journey/:programId
Search/filter drawer: filter icon shows search bar and division/region dropdowns
Mobile responsiveness: stats hide on mobile, buttons show icons only
Color bars: teal for outreach, amber for waiting, green for conversation (verified in code)
Urgency badges show for waiting schools with due dates ('Due in 1d', 'Due in 3d')
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing (pipeline-card-*, section-*, filter-*, view-*, etc.)
Responsive design uses correct Tailwind classes (hidden md:flex for stats, hidden sm:inline for button text)
Color scheme consistent: teal (#2ec4b6) for outreach, amber (#f59e0b) for waiting, green (#16a34a) for conversation, gold (#d97706) for committed
Card expand loads interactions via API call (lazy loading) - good performance pattern
Section collapse state managed correctly with useState
forceExpand prop correctly syncs with viewMode for Expanded view toggle
seed_data_creation: Used existing 10 demo schools in pipeline
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pipeline UI redesign fully tested and working. All 10 schools display across 4 sections (Needs Outreach: 2, Waiting on Reply: 3, In Conversation: 4, Committed: 1). Features verified: expandable cards, collapsible sections, filter chips, view toggle, search/filter drawer, action buttons, navigation to journey page, mobile responsiveness, urgency badges. 'Mark as Replied' button removed as requested - now only available via timeline on Journey page.
